CommunityApplications.Profile:
Server-side software for Flotilla Push. Flotilla is an iOS app for Unraid and Proxmox VE servers.
This repository contains the Unraid plugin, a companion daemon for Proxmox VE, and the encryption tool that both of them use. All of the code is public and has an MIT license.
The plugin sends the notifications from your server to your phone. It encrypts the content of each event on the server, before the data goes out of your local network. The relay that sends the push message cannot read your notifications.
Use the support topic on the Unraid forums for questions and problem reports.
